content.body:
The Panzer II C was the natural evolution of the Wehrmacht early training tanks, up-gunned with a 20 mm automatic cannon in place of the light machinegun Panzer I from the interwar years. Due to production delays and teething problems with the early Panzer III's and IV's, the Panzer II C ended up being deployed in unexpected numbers. It was in fact used as a main battle tank in Poland, where more than 90% of the tanks used were Panzer I's and II's.
CONTROLS & VARIATIONS Driver (position 1) starts with the vision slit open. Press O to drop the shield. Press Numpad . to cycle through zoom levels (will not work when shield is down).
As the Commander/Gunner (position 2), press 0 to unbutton/button. Guns may be fired this way, but they cannot be aimed.
When buttoned, press Numpad . to cycle through the zoom levels. Use Page Up and Page Down to adjust the range setting of the gun sights.
